explanation: The first king of Israel who was chosen by God through the prophet Samuel.
A prophet and judge in Israel who anointed both Saul and David to be kings.
A person who claims to have supernatural powers and abilities, such as communicating with spirits.
A village in Israel where Saul visited a witch to contact the spirit of Samuel.
An immaterial being, often associated with a human soul or divine beings.
The practice of communicating with the dead to gain information or guidance.
An ancient people group who were enemies of Israel and lived in Canaan.
The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created heaven, earth, and all life.
